author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Proving every naysayer wrong, the LEGO films proved that a movie based on toys could deliver clever storytelling, incredible animation, and a surprising amount of heart. LEGO Batman, in particular, managed to capture the Dark Knight's complicated personality in a way that many live-action adaptations struggle to get right.

But the magic behind these movies goes far beyond their jokes and recognizable characters. The original LEGO Movie developed a distinctive visual style that made its computer animation look like real LEGO creations brought to life, with every brick and minifigure designed to feel authentic. Yet when The LEGO Movie 2: The Second Part arrived, it struggled to recapture the same excitement and cultural impact as its predecessor.

So what made these LEGO movies work so well in the first place? Why is LEGO Batman such a faithful adaptation of the Caped Crusader? And what went wrong with the sequel?

#lego #legomovie #legobatman #nerdstalgic
title: What Happened to LEGO Movies?
